status: Feasibility calculations and proposed dimensions only. No BR1 CAD yet. Powered fixture, guard and instrumentation are incomplete. DO NOT POWER.

evidence.drum_od_bore_pcd: Published by Azusa. The 3/8-inch mounting-hole option is selected; verify the exact supplied pattern.
evidence.drum_depth_face_wall_mass: Unverified assumptions. Measure or obtain a supplier drawing before printing the rotor or running a brake test.
evidence.hub_body_and_pilot: Local manufacturer STEP has 22 mm total axial extent, including a 2 mm pilot. 38 mm rotating envelope conservatively covers its 26 x 26 mm bounding box.
evidence.rope_and_heat_capacity: Engineering trial assumptions; neither friction coefficient nor local contact temperature is established.
evidence.rope_radius: Use the measured perpendicular distance from shaft center to each loaded rope centerline. Nominal (drum diameter + rope diameter)/2 is only a starting estimate.
evidence.force_limits: Provisional test limits used to screen bearing/shaft loads, not certified fixture ratings. Complete mounting, guard, rope selection, calibrated gauges and a load-release mechanism before power.
